title: Sheet 01 · Observed Room
summary: Atlas's grid over a picture, made Kelwin's drawing sheet. The observed room sits under cool night frost with the 12-column frame drawn over it. The founder's left stack is set as an uppercase sheet title on the 96px row module, with the red audit cell docked to the band. A viewport onto the room fills cols 9–12, with a spec cell and a title block. Palantir-grade rigour with no HUD.

reference.site: Atlas — 'The physical layer of autonomy' hero
reference.borrowed: Atlas lays its site grid over a full-bleed image as faint full-height 1px verticals, like a drafting sheet over a photograph. Tiny bordered caps nav cells sit beside the logo with a distinct action cell at top-right. An uppercase headline docks its lines to the column lines.
reference.kelwin: The painterly sky becomes the frosted film under cool night frost (sat .42, frost .28, blur 9px). The plate is feathered into the dark ground on the viewport side, so the colleague bent over the table and the seated one read as people while the title cell stays calm graphite. Atlas's verticals become Kelwin's 12-column frame: frame rules at 64 and 1376, a col-9 divider between the title cell and the viewport, and 9px crosshairs at the four sheet corners plus two chosen points (an empty intersection in the title cell, and the spec cell's corner). None of them sit on the people. The nav cells become the 64px cell nav, labels set bottom-left at a 16px inset: lockup cell, five tracked-caps menu cells, a sheet-index cell (SHEET 01/14, which advances per section on the live site), and an outlined 'AUDIT REQUEST ↗' cell. The docked headline becomes the founder's left stack on the row module: '■ GTM SYSTEMS PARTNER' in the header row, then 'REVENUE IS AN / ARCHITECTURAL' in Mona wide 430 caps. 'PROBLEM.' turns light (300, --fg-3), one line per 96px row. The 48×2 red rule and the 20px lede follow. In row 8 the red 'INITIATE SYSTEM AUDIT ↗' cell (cols 1–3, with a mono cell ID) sits beside the underlined 'TALK TO THE TEAM →'. Bottom-right, the founder's annotation becomes a spec cell: '■ A FIXED-SCOPE DIAGNOSTIC' over DURATION · Ten working days / OUTPUT · Clear findings / THEN · Actionable recommendations. The 48px band carries the L1–L4 layer legend and the title block 'FIG. 1.0 · OBSERVED ROOM · REV C'. There is no red plane in the hero.

motion: entrance (drafting order, --ease-inout, no overshoot): the frame rules and crosshairs fade in (300ms). The nav cells appear left→right as their borders draw top-down (40ms stagger). The column lines plot top-down via stroke-dashoffset (600ms, 40ms stagger). The label fades in, the three title lines rise out of their 96px row masks (120ms stagger, the light turn line last), and the red rule draws. The lede fades in, and the red audit cell drops into its slot with an 8px settle (400ms). The contact path, the spec cell and its rows fade in. The mono values (legend, cell ID, title block) type on at 24ms per character, and the X/Y readout ticks from 0.00 to 0.42 · 0.18.

ambient: only the film loops: the 32s drift, a silhouette crossing, and the frosted-glass grain. Direction C's 6s UTC readout is deliberately dropped, because it echoed today's hero 'UTC | 15:45:45' status line, which the founder finds generic.

interaction: the X/Y readout and its tick ride the top sheet rule across the viewport with the cursor, reading live sheet coordinates, and return to rest on leave. Hovered nav cells (including the outlined audit cell) invert to --fg fill with --bg text. The red audit cell deepens to --accent-hover with ↗ moving 2px up-right, and the contact underline turns --fg as → nudges 3px.

on the live site: the frame verticals continue down the page as the drawing set's frame, and the nav's sheet-index cell advances per section (SHEET 02/14 …). Reduced motion shows the fully plotted sheet.
notes: Rebuilt in the critique pass. The previous version put the lede and both CTAs in a cols 9–12 note cell, which is the Plurel split hero the founder's latest spec forbids. It also lacked the red rule and the light accent phrase, and filled the nav action red, which meant two red fills per viewport. The left stack now runs on the 96px row module, and cols 9–12 became the viewport onto the room. Title at 96px: with the spec tracking, 100px pushed 'ARCHITECTURAL' to the col-9 divider. The film is eased to frost .28 and brightness 1.14, as C's plan and the calibration note allow; at .55/.7 the people merged into the dark wall. The plate is feathered with a mask so its mirrored half never shows. Arrows are drawn as SVG because the brand fonts have no ↗ or → glyphs. Also replaced the ticking UTC nav cell with a static sheet-index cell, because it repeated today's hero status line.
